text_block_list.name: Creek & Inari
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: —Ooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Who will make their move!?
Who will conquer this 'dream' race!?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (――Blaze bright!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
BAMBOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!
MEMORRRRRRRRYYYYYYYYY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory surges forward!!
Bamboo Memory extends her stride!!
Bamboo Memory is pulling away with sheer power!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory crosses the finish line!!!
The ruler of sprints and miles!!
Has conquered this "dream" race——!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...You really are showin' us a "dream," aren't ya?
Right, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo & City
text_block_list.text:
"I want to, one more time—
I want to, one more time—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Complete... burnout――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —There's no way I can do that, sir!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! Not yet, not yet, not yet!!
More, more, moooore!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I... We can put on
the greatest race ever!
I wanna run the greatest race ever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So this isn't the end...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Our "dream" will never end!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
Now that's some admirable greed!
But that's just who you are, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm going to aim even higher and push further beyond than Bamboo-san!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
I wonder just how far we can go?
It's so exciting, isn't it~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... as long as we have beloved rivals by our side,
our radiance, and our "dreams," will become boundless—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—I'm looking forward to it.
Aiming for the top among this crowd.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Without fail, next time I will be the one who wins."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let us take on the challenge again and again.
Let us run together, over and over.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who gives people “dreams”—
Bamboo Memory!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep showing them.
That we are the ones who—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That we're the greatest generation of all!!
